name: drone-inspection
description: Turbine blade and solar panel defect detection with browser-based inference
comment: onnxruntime-web is a devDependency, not a runtime one: the deployed site loads it from
a CDN (see web/js/runtime.js). The local copy exists so tests/test_web.mjs can serve it
and run offline. Set `runtime.ortBase` in web/models/manifest.json to self-host it in
playwright is not listed here — it is large and only the test needs it. Install it with
`npm install --no-save playwright@1.56.1 && npx playwright install chromium`, as CI does.
